**What happened**

A short description of the behavior you saw.

**What you expected**

The promise the behavior contradicts - a sentence from the README, a package
README, a doc comment, or the error text itself.

**Reproduction**

The smallest code that shows it. A failing test in a fresh module is ideal;
the version (`go list -m github.com/dreamsxin/go-kit/v2`) and `go version`
are required either way.
